text:
Gases can be compressed, but liquids cannot.
Which statement explains this difference?
A
Each molecule in a gas is more compressible than each molecule in a liquid.
B
Molecules in a gas are further apart than molecules in a liquid.
C
Molecules in a gas attract each other more strongly than molecules in a liquid.
D
Molecules in a gas move more slowly than molecules in a liquid.

options.label: A
options.text: Each molecule in a gas is more compressible than each molecule in a liquid.

options.label: B
options.text: Molecules in a gas are further apart than molecules in a liquid.

options.label: C
options.text: Molecules in a gas attract each other more strongly than molecules in a liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: Molecules in a gas move more slowly than molecules in a liquid.
